snippet.textDisplay:
GTA VI is the game of the century. Anyone whom disputes that just has no idea what makes a great game..epic. 

I'm using a Samsung Oled to double the frame rate to 60fps and my pc capture card to output with DLSS 5 added. That combination is unmatched graphically by any game, it's not even close. (i should know as i have a high end rig w/5090)

Playing off a XSX and PS5 Pro and will get the PC version once launched. 

I put in 20 hours into this game and it easily will give me 200+ hours to completion.

This is not a game it's an experience and a landmark of gaming and it's technical brilliance sets the bar no game will match for a long time.

snippet.textDisplay: I have logged 2,000 hours across GTA V and GTA V Online, and I have played everything since San Andreas. This game is incredibly good. The online component also holds enormous potential, though I remain skeptical; still, I cannot wait to see it. For now, I have played four missions and accumulated 10 hours of gameplay. I disliked the slowness of RDR2, so I assumed this approach would not work for me, but it truly did in this instance. It is a masterpiece.
